usedFor: Seven Time holds customers, projects and work orders, and Calendly offers a booking link via “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Seven Time, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new customer can book a first call through a link made on the spot.

watchOut: “Create Scheduling Link” only makes the link, so sending it to the customer is a separate step.
